sections.Profile:
The Show Boat pinball machine, produced by D. Gottlieb & Co. in April 1961, is an electro-mechanical single-player game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. It features a riverboat theme inspired by the Broadway musical "Show Boat."

- Years made: 1961
